takes.title: Two friends
takes.markdown:
## 1. Two friends

[Scene 1. A dark stage. The street map is not there yet. Two dots, then the city, then the gap between them, then the texts that go nowhere.]

Two friends, [beat] one city, [beat] forty minutes apart. [beat] So they text, [beat] and they never meet.
takes.text:
Two friends, —

one city, —

forty minutes apart. —

So they text, —

and they never meet.

takes.title: Halfway
takes.markdown:
## 2. Halfway

[Scene 2. The same map. The wordmark, two address fields, a pin at the fair point, two equal arcs, a cafe card, and one time label on each side.]

Halfway finds the fair spot. [beat] Type two addresses. [beat] We drop a pin where it takes you both the same time, [beat] [beat] at a place worth the trip. [beat] Twenty minutes for her. [beat] Twenty minutes for you.
takes.text:
Halfway finds the fair spot. —

Type two addresses. —

We drop a pin where it takes you both the same time, —

at a place worth the trip. —

Twenty minutes for her. —

Twenty minutes for you.

takes.title: Last month
takes.markdown:
## 3. Last month

[Scene 3. A counter on the map, then three small pictures for what people did there. The number is the monthly figure and is the edit moment.]

Last month, fourteen thousand people met in the middle. [beat] Coffee. [beat] Lunch. [beat] One first date [beat] that became a second.
takes.text:
Last month, fourteen thousand people met in the middle. —

Coffee. —

Lunch. —

One first date —

that became a second.

takes.title: This year
takes.markdown:
## 4. This year

[Scene 4. The map pulls back to a country outline. Five new pins, one empty chair at a cafe table, the wordmark, and the tagline drawn word by word.]

This year, five more cities, [beat] and one more seat at the table. [beat] Halfway. [beat] Meet in the middle.
takes.text:
This year, five more cities, —

and one more seat at the table. —

Halfway. —

Meet in the middle.
